goal: Makes RPCs and internal transaction lookup correctly report I/O errors instead of silently treating them as 'transaction not found'.
Prevents wrong or misleading error messages when txindex disk reads fail.
reviewability: Stale: needs rebase and author has been silent for 62 days, past the staleness threshold.
A reviewer flagged a likely regression for pruned-block lookups that remains unaddressed.
agreement: Two concept ACKs with no substantive objection to the overall direction (yuvicc, musaHaruna).
yuvicc raised an unresolved concern that a pruned-block lookup would now wrongly return an I/O error message instead of 'Block not available', with no author reply.
A style nit about wrapping the new test in try/finally was discussed but not adopted, not a blocking concern (musaHaruna).

result.summary: This PR changes GetTransaction and TxIndex::FindTx to distinguish 'transaction not found' from internal I/O errors, returning util::Expected instead of a flat bool/nullable pointer so callers can throw a proper RPC error rather than silently reporting a missing transaction. It updates getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, rest_tx, and ProcessPSBT to surface these errors, and adds a new functional test simulating a block file I/O failure.
result.problem: Currently a disk read failure (e.g. txindex corruption or a missing block file) is indistinguishable from a transaction simply not existing, so RPC callers and PSBT processing get a misleading 'not found' result instead of a clear error, which could mask underlying storage problems for node operators and RPC consumers.

open_concerns: yuvicc pointed out that for pruned mode, getrawtransaction with a pruned block hash would now return 'I/O error reading block data' instead of the previous 'Block not available' message, a likely behavioral regression, with a proposed functional test; author has not responded.
musaHaruna suggested wrapping the new test's file rename/restore in try/finally for safety; author pushed back questioning the need, discussion trailed off without resolution.

result.card: This PR makes GetTransaction and TxIndex::FindTx return a proper error instead of silently treating disk I/O failures as 'transaction not found', fixing a real but rare correctness gap that could mislead RPC callers (getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, ProcessPSBT) during txindex disk corruption. The strongest evidence of importance is the author's own rationale: 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly.' The PR is draft, needs rebase, and the author has been silent for 62 days; a reviewer (yuvicc) flagged an apparent regression in pruned-node error messages that remains unaddressed. It conflicts with several other open PRs touching the same files (#35676, #35531, #34729, #24230), and has two unelaborated concept ACKs but no resolved objections.
